question: Does excess multi-stop spread of route-new species persist when observer identity and physical stop identity are simultaneously held constant?
sample: Intersection of same-observer matched pairs and pairs with all ten nonmissing identical SiteID values between wet and dry runs.
endpoint: extra_stop_incidence_gain = sum over wet route-new species of max(number of wet stops occupied - 1, 0).
null_training: Dry-history probabilities use only dry runs from the selected robustness subset; candidate species pools retain the existing eligible-run union.
pass_rule: Observed rain-contrast coefficient for extra_stop_incidence_gain exceeds the upper 95% interval under both null families.
interpretation: A pass supports coordinated multi-stop recruitment beyond observer turnover and stop relocation; it does not identify individual movement or hydrological cause.
